description: Create a one-time, origin-bound viewer link for a supervised session, for the person who will watch and take over. Give viewer_url to that person (one click opens the session). The admission_code in it works once and expires after expires_in_seconds. Never send passwords or other site credentials through chat: the person signs in themselves, in the viewer.

session_id.description: Supervised session ID. Defaults to this connection's active session.

name: create_viewer_grant
title: Create viewer link
